verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents mobile receipt capture and uploading receipts and memos through its free mobile app. It also sends automated emails to employees when a receipt or memo is missing. Nothing shows receipts can be emailed in, or that uploaded receipts are automatically matched to the correct card transaction. Missing for 10: email-forwarding receipt ingestion, automatic receipt-to-transaction matching, web/desktop upload, independent or hands-on corroboration.
